items.subject: Lancer
items.original_finding: Mechanical consistency and source fidelity require review; receipt has no normalized limitations field.
items.decision: Keep two locomotor legs; recoil strut terminates on rear leg, never a third foot. Fix hip-lance axis across four views.
items.next_evidence: Matched front/side/rear/top views with two feet and strut endpoints annotated.

items.subject: Relay Skiff
items.original_finding: Concept illustration only; secondary-emitter leader points near a lift pod and requires clarified attachment placement before production. Tactical inset is a top-view rendering, not a tested gameplay silhouette. Dimensions and multiview geometry remain unverified.
items.decision: Keep mast/dish and sealed archive cradle. Put the secondary emitter at the front centerline, visibly separate from lift pods; remove misleading leader.
items.next_evidence: Matched attachment detail and underside view; cradle stays unchanged across all motion unless an authoritative event replaces it.

items.subject: Future Well
items.original_finding: Single concept sheet, not animation, scale, collision or packaged RTS evidence. Harvest direction of collapse and Dormant doubled shadow require clearer motion/detail references; the spent inset communicates permanence. Crossing is an illustrative possible feature, not approved map geometry.
items.decision: Keep one bowl/spire family. Use amber-collapse as a labeled candidate study only; do not resolve contradictory REL-ART-014 wording by changing runtime.
items.next_evidence: Reconcile Harvest authority; then source-driven Dormant/telegraph/commit/spent and Preserve/Reshape timelines with interrupt/expiry cases.

items.subject: Surveyor
items.original_finding: Illustrative derived views, not verified orthographics or animation. Three canisters are a visual proposal, not cargo-capacity units; exact cradle geometry, weld tip, movement and scale need production review.
items.decision: Keep exactly three visible cargo canisters as packaging choice, never as capacity. Drill arm and gripper/welder arm keep their sides; active tool follows action state.
items.next_evidence: Four-view cradle and tool head sheet; planted gait and stop/cancel tool shutdown study.

items.subject: Bulwark Team
items.original_finding: Mechanical consistency and source fidelity require review; receipt has no normalized limitations field.
items.decision: Preserve owner-approved centered six panes, 01–03 left and04–06 right. No center seventh pane. Pack by three-panel linked chains with fields off.
items.next_evidence: Matched packed/deployed plan and side clearances; six persistent panel identities throughout motion.

items.subject: Tender
items.original_finding: Face, clothing and tool shape are candidate interpretations. Pose/clothing consistency, scale, rig and RTS readability remain unverified.
items.decision: Retain current mineral cultivator, finished work apron, forked resonance staff and woven sling. Same clothing pattern and tool in every pose; no new character canon.
items.next_evidence: Four-view turn sheet plus gather/kneel/stand/grow/carry cycle preserving attire and staff length.

items.subject: Anchor
items.original_finding: Top-view inset remains oblique rather than orthographic. Mast proportions and damage transitions require consistent views in later development. Doorway size, conduit routes and aprons are illustrative, not approved gameplay footprint or navigation changes.
items.decision: Retain three worker bays and separate intake. Use the main-view mast proportions as reference target; locate all access on a common overhead plan.
items.next_evidence: Single geometry source yielding front/side/rear/top with clear bay/intake paths; later fit to authoritative footprint.

items.subject: Power Link
items.original_finding: Illustrative candidate, not verified orthographic geometry.
items.decision: Four numbered ceramic access panels, one collar assembly, low base and physical paired conduits define the component inventory.
items.next_evidence: Matched orthographic views from a single geometry source.

items.subject: Power Link
items.original_finding: Maintenance inset opening spans panels 02 and 03 but only one removed panel is pictured.
items.decision: Show both removed panels02 and03 alongside the exposed two-panel opening. Retain an unplugged connector.
items.next_evidence: Corrected image inspected; does not certify coupling mechanics.

evidence.scope: Specific image-level defect only; not production acceptance

items.subject: Power Link
items.original_finding: Coupling layout and dimensions require engineering reference review; RTS readability and performance untested.
items.decision: Keep two paired conduit routes as visual connections; do not infer network radius from painted cable length.
items.next_evidence: Dimensioned couplings and RTS/performance evidence after authorized blockout/import.

items.subject: Array Foundry

items.decision: Interrupted means stopped rail and dim research activity; separate permanent service accents from active fabrication lights.
items.next_evidence: Matched three-state emissive mask sheet and state transition test.

items.subject: Array Foundry
items.original_finding: Unit frame is illustrative, not a new approved unit.
items.decision: The painted assembly is a reference volume only. Future production shots use the selected existing Meridian unit family, not a new roster entry.
items.next_evidence: A selected approved unit model must replace the placeholder before final production acceptance.

items.subject: Array Foundry
items.original_finding: Long visual hall must be reconciled with observed 4x4 gameplay footprint; dimensions and orthographic consistency are not verified.
items.decision: Keep authoritative 4x4 occupancy. Fit a rectangular visible hall inside it; approach aprons may not create new collision or navigation authority.
items.next_evidence: Scaled top-down fit and entity path sweep on approved blockout.

items.subject: Array Foundry
items.original_finding: No RTS, art, gameplay or technical acceptance gate completed.
items.decision: Keep all three acceptance gates open. Candidate art is not a gate result.
items.next_evidence: Art fidelity, gameplay camera and technical performance evidence.

items.subject: Array Foundry
items.original_finding: Far exterior portals are occluded from this angle; orthographic clearance verification remains required.
items.decision: Opposite short-end openings lie on the same longitudinal rail axis. No side exit.
items.next_evidence: True plan and end elevation with continuous track and clearance envelope.

items.subject: Aegis Post
items.original_finding: Third leg is obscured or absent in rear inset; that inset cannot establish complete tripod geometry.
items.decision: Three radial supports only. Top-down mount supplement sets a candidate 120-degree topology; it does not prove hidden leg geometry.
items.next_evidence: Single geometry source produces all views with three feet.

items.subject: Aegis Post
items.original_finding: Main rear-leg attachment and cross-view mechanical consistency require correction in orthographic reference development.
items.decision: All legs attach below azimuth bearing to stationary hub; elevation cradle and head carry no ground leg.
items.next_evidence: 360-degree azimuth and elevation clearance study, with fixed support attachment inventory.

items.subject: Aegis Post
items.original_finding: Offline muzzle rims retain blue tint; ensure zero emissive output in future materials.
items.decision: Offline emissive output is zero for band and muzzles. A blue material tint is not an active light. Stop tracking/firing/audio on power loss independently of droop completion.
items.next_evidence: Offline material mask and authoritative power-loss test still required.

items.subject: Aegis Post
items.original_finding: Scale, footprint, rotation clearances, RTS readability and technical gates unverified.
items.decision: Retain 2x2 authoritative footprint; neither feet nor cables may silently expand navigation collision.
items.next_evidence: Scaled mount, rotation envelopes and tactical camera tests in authorized integration lane.

items.subject: Memory Hearth
items.original_finding: Interior furnishings and exact spire/hollow arrangement are candidate interpretations, not book-established facts.
items.decision: Keep inhabited hollows but treat furniture as optional set dressing. Crown/hollow counts must follow one selected main-view layout; no claim those counts came from the novel.
items.next_evidence: Freeze a plan before modeling; omit unapproved interior dressing from required silhouette.

items.subject: Memory Hearth
items.original_finding: Damage view is cropped at right edge and has geometric differences; not verified state-matched modeling reference.
items.decision: Use the healthy dome as geometry source for damage. Keep intact portions identical and frame the complete structure.
items.next_evidence: Matched full-frame healthy/damaged views from one fixed camera.

items.subject: Memory Hearth
items.original_finding: A dark spire is not unambiguously differentiated; damaged-state lighting needs refinement.
items.decision: Designate one crown spire for damage: extinguish its amber seam and visibly break its tip; fracture only a bounded adjacent shell region.
items.next_evidence: Side-by-side damage mask and localized fracture study.

items.subject: Memory Hearth
items.original_finding: Scale, 5x5 footprint fit, orthographic consistency, construction/destruction and RTS acceptance remain unverified.
items.decision: Fit shell/hollows/cleft inside the 5x5 authority and establish entrance clearances before detailing.
items.next_evidence: Scaled blockout, construction/collapse sequence and gameplay acceptance.

items.subject: Waystone
items.original_finding: Carriage pad mechanism and folded root arrangement are proposed visual interpretations; gait, weight transfer and root conservation not verified.
items.decision: Retain distinct anchoring roots and broad carriage pads. Roots clear ground before translation; carriage stays supported; no floating or sliding support feet.
items.next_evidence: Contact-phase gait and measured root conservation across a full uproot/root cycle.

items.subject: Waystone
items.original_finding: Root-detail folded tip appears close to ground; not a clearance-certified mechanical view.
items.decision: Retracted root tips terminate above the carriage contact plane; no tip drags while migrating.
items.next_evidence: Orthographic side view with ground plane and positive clearance measurement.

items.subject: Waystone
items.original_finding: Scale, 2x2 gameplay footprint fit, docking access, rigging and RTS readability remain unverified.
items.decision: Keep mobile form within the authoritative movement contract; root-only logistics/drop-off cannot persist while migrating.
items.next_evidence: 2x2 rooted fit, mobile clearance and state-bound logistics tests.

items.subject: Waystone
items.original_finding: No acceptance or production maturity advancement.
items.decision: Keep NOT_STARTED production maturity and unaccepted gate states until separately authorized production evidence exists.
items.next_evidence: Stage evidence and owner acceptance; never infer from this audit.

items.subject: Riftstalker
items.original_finding: Four-limb anatomy is a candidate design decision, not established by prose.
items.decision: Use four locomotor limbs as delegated candidate design choice. It is not a prose-derived anatomical fact.
items.next_evidence: Consistent four-limb turn sheet before rigging.

items.subject: Riftstalker
items.original_finding: Exact anatomical side of caster and attachment consistency require orthographic verification.
items.decision: One caster on anatomical left shoulder; preserve that side through turns. It attaches through grown saddle/tendon, not a mechanical turret.
items.next_evidence: Left/right elevations with identified body axes and attachment detail.

items.subject: Riftstalker
items.original_finding: Carapace and weapon overlap may impair RTS weapon identification; silhouette recognition untested.
items.decision: Separate caster mouth from head/brow silhouette with a clear notch and negative space; preserve light skirmisher frame.
items.next_evidence: Small tactical silhouette comparison at equivalent scale.

items.subject: Riftstalker
items.original_finding: Damage separation is not unambiguously depicted; molting, sidestep sequence, rig, scale and acceptance gates remain open.
items.decision: Localized saddle split is damage; firing sidestep is cosmetic and cannot alter simulation position. Molt variants retain body identity.
items.next_evidence: Bounded damage detail, side-step pose sequence and carapace/striker variants tied to authoritative events.

items.subject: Cairnback
items.original_finding: Quadrupedal tortoise-like anatomy is candidate interpretation; far limbs partly occluded.
items.decision: Use four short load-bearing limbs and low protected head. Keep broad layered back identity, no giant jewel or gun.
items.next_evidence: Matched anatomy views; no assertion of canonical limb count.

items.subject: Cairnback
items.original_finding: Cover study shows resulting barrier, not a verified heave animation or ground-gap clearance.
items.decision: Cover action has brace/heave/recovery. A detached terrain barrier remains behind; no tail-wall or permanent body extrusion.
items.next_evidence: Side sequence with visible ground gap after release; barrier creation follows authoritative event.

items.subject: Cairnback
items.original_finding: Barrier proportions and placement need reconciliation with gameplay source; no dimension or runtime changes.
items.decision: Barrier silhouette must fit actual mineral_cover geometry and duration, never derive coverage from illustration.
items.next_evidence: Source-bound barrier dimensions, footprint and placement tests.

items.subject: Cairnback
items.original_finding: Scale, gait, attack interface, destruction, RTS readability and acceptance gates unverified.
items.decision: Mass and slow turn are visual language, not permission to change speed or combat.
items.next_evidence: Rig, attack presentation, slump/debris, navigation and RTS validation.

items.subject: Resonant
items.original_finding: Quadrupedal anatomy and fin arrangement are candidate interpretations; cross-pose anatomy, gait and rig unverified.
items.decision: Keep four delicate grounded limbs, small inclined head and thin amber fins. Freeze fin positions on one anatomical spine before further poses.
items.next_evidence: Matched anatomy and fin inventory; gait support study.

items.subject: Resonant
items.original_finding: Static image cannot validate sequential fin brightening or detection timing.
items.decision: A localized brightness wave travels along fins; reduced motion uses a stable highlighted group. No flashing whole-body effect.
items.next_evidence: Event-driven sequence/recovery study; no target identity revelation.

items.subject: Resonant
items.original_finding: Visual brief says listens, does not fight, but observed gameplay source includes attack damage 8/range 380; attack presentation unresolved, no gameplay change inferred.
items.decision: Preserve authored anti-scout attack capability. Do not add a visible cannon merely to explain stats; weapon form remains a canon/requirements reconciliation.
items.next_evidence: Resolve SPEC-UNIT-008 combat presentation against Bible language, then author acquire/attack/recovery.

items.subject: Resonant
items.original_finding: Scale, RTS readability, materials budget and acceptance gates remain unverified.
items.decision: Transparent fins must remain legible without excessive overdraw or high-frequency motion.
items.next_evidence: Scale, material budget and target-device gameplay-camera test.

items.subject: Growth Basin
items.original_finding: Resting pool now darker than growing pool; image-level state contrast improved. Gameplay-camera recognition remains unverified.
items.decision: Keep corrected dark resting pool versus bright growing pool; test shape/occupancy cues as color redundancy.
items.next_evidence: Gameplay-camera state recognition and reduced-motion checks.

items.subject: Growth Basin
items.original_finding: Pool pattern may read as solid mineral; liquid-mineral motion remains undefined.
items.decision: Matrix is liquid-mineral: slow traveling surface ripples and subsurface lattice, no rigid cracked crust.
items.next_evidence: Loop study with uninterrupted fluid surface and paused/rest state.

items.subject: Growth Basin
